description: ADTS at 22050 Hz of six channel pairs followed by SBR payloads whose header (start frequency 0, stop frequency 8, linear scale) needs six patches at 44100 Hz, where the standard allows five: the payloads are not read, and the stream is HE-AAC from the payloads' presence.
findings: the frequency tables need 6 patches, more than the 5 the standard allows
6 of 6 raw data blocks hold SBR data: the stream is HE-AAC

skip.faad: faad -i prints twice the rate of any ADTS stream at 24 kHz or less, whatever its frames hold.
skip.decode: ffmpeg builds the patches of six and decodes the data.
